title: Anthropic API: Unexpected Reduction in Claude Code MAX Plan Usage Limits
body:
**Bug Description**
Claude code limits on MAX plan have been cut in half silently. I code every single day and have never reached the 5 hour limit. Since a few days ago, I can only get 2-3 hours before I limit out. There are a plethora of users reporting the same on github and redit. There is obviously a significant and silent limit cut that does not justify $200/month for the MAX plan.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: vscode
- Version: 1.0.53
- Feedback ID: 050bb257-347d-4f39-8db3-36f145d311b5

top_comments.author: tibbon
top_comments.body: For the past two days I've been hitting my rate limits _far_ earlier than I would expect. I wonder if something has changed. My context is filling up rather quickly too - despite me shrinking my CLAUDE.md by 90%

top_comments.author: jlmacedo
top_comments.body: I'm too, every day I've hitting my rate limits twice by day. Maybe is for high demand of the Claude Code
